jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Implementation (U.S.A. Remote)
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics
, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Project Manager
for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics is responsible for overseeing and leading mid-to-large scale multi-discipline installations within a Clinical Laboratory environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of instrumentation, data management, and automation system solutions implementations. They will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration, efficient operation, and optimal performance of the laboratory solution implementation.

This position reports to the Manager, Project Management and is part of the Solutions One Project Management Team located in the US
and will be fully remote
.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead and manage the entire implementation lifecycle of mid to large-scale multi-discipline installations within Clinical Laboratory settings.
Develop and execute instrumentation project plans, ensuring customer readiness and adherence to timelines, budget, and quality standards.
Coordinate and collaborate with various stakeholders, including laboratory directors, engineers, technicians, and vendors to ensure successful project implementation.
Conduct comprehensive assessments of laboratory infrastructure, and readiness requirements to recommend appropriate instrumentation, data management, and automation system solutions timeline
Oversee the procurement and installation of equipment, ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines and industry best practices.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

B.S. Degree with 5+ years of Project Management experience
Proven track record in managing projects, and be able to provide examples and project artifacts, i.e., Communication Plans, Project Plans, Risk Plans, etc.
Advanced understanding of the Diagnostics or Healthcare Industry with a heavy emphasis on the Laboratory Regulatory environment.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Project Management software such as Smartsheet
Experience reading and interpreting floor plans and design drawings

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel Monday-Friday, 80% nationally
Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Construction and IT experience in Project Management
PMP Certification is a plus.
Background in Medical Technology and work experience
Familiarity with Standard Laboratory Practices, including Quality Control, record keeping, and regulatory requirements (CAP, CLIA, COLA)

Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics can provide.

The annual salary range for this role is $120,000-$127,000
. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.description:
Depuis plus de 80 ans, Natus s’engage à répondre aux besoins variés des cliniciens, en proposant des solutions de la plus haute qualité pour améliorer la qualité des soins prodigués aux patients, où qu’ils soient.

Nos solutions diagnostiques et thérapeutiques sensorielles complètes sont conçues pour simplifier les flux de travail des spécialistes, garantissant aux équipes soignantes les instruments adaptés pour apporter aux patients le soutien nécessaire et une plus grande tranquillité d’esprit.

Location:
Remote somewhere in Europe

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Project Manager with 6 to 9 years of experience
to lead the deployment, integration, and optimization of our core Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
systems, Artificial Intelligence (AI)
initiatives, and broader Business Applications
.

In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between our technical engineering teams, data scientists, and business stakeholders. You will drive end-to-end delivery of complex software environments, ensuring that our technical ecosystem aligns with organizational goals and scales efficiently. Exposure to or experience with Salesforce is a distinct plus
, but not a hard requirement.

Key Responsibilities

Project Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end execution of enterprise application projects, from initial scoping and requirement gathering through to design, implementation, UAT, deployment, and post-launch support.
ERP & Systems Integration: Oversee the planning, configuration, and roll-out of ERP modules and integrations with existing internal business applications to streamline operational workflows.
AI Solution Delivery: Partner with data science and engineering teams to deploy modern, AI-enabled delivery practices, automation tools, and machine learning models into everyday business operations.
Stakeholder & Change Management: Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional business heads to manage expectations, define clear KPIs, and drive organizational change management to ensure high user adoption of new tools.
Risk & Resource Management: Proactively identify project dependencies, technical blockers, and budget risks. Formulate strategic countermeasures to keep timelines on track without sacrificing quality.
Agile Governance: Facilitate standard agile/scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming) tailored to mixed software implementation models.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 6–9 years of dedicated project management experience within enterprise software implementation, specifically managing core business applications and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite).
AI & Automation Exposure: Proven track record of managing projects that involve AI core concepts, LLM integrations, business process automation, or data analytics pipelines.
Methodologies: Strong mastery of Agile, Scrum, or SAFe frameworks alongside traditional Waterfall project governance.
Tools: High proficiency with modern project management and collaboration toolsets (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Asana).
Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to translate dense technical architectures into clear, value-driven language for C-suite stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. PMP, PMI-ACP, or Scrum Master (CSM) certifications are highly valued.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

Hands-on implementation experience or structural knowledge of the Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or MuleSoft integrations).
Practical exposure to utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools within project delivery workflows.

jobs.title: ERTS Project Manager
jobs.description:
Clean Harbors is seeking an ERTS Project Manager. The ERTS Project Manager is primarily responsible for ensuring that all jobs performed for a specific client, or groups of clients are properly scoped, quoted and executed safety and efficiently to meet the clients' expectations. This role also provides the full range of project management, and supervision required for the successful performance, and completion of projects. This is a remote position and can sit anywhere in the US.

Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

Why work for Clean Harbors ?

Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!

Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth

Competitive Pay Range: $60K-$70K

Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment including 401K with Company match

Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career

Company paid training and tuition reimbursement

Responsibilities

Responsible for the project management of emergency spill response management.
Responsible for managing all phases of spill response including, working directly with clients to ensure a timely successful spill cleanup, regulatory compliance, with client with safety and cost effectiveness in mind.
Create and manage remedial work to include development of Scope of work, Development of Request for quote (RFQ) validation of quotes received to assure the most equipped and best contractor response is awarded to assure a complete closure of the incident.
Accurately log information from client interactions into ALERT systems; update in a timely and accurate manner so that clients can track services inquiries and resolution.
Review analytical results to ensure compliance meeting specific state/province requirement and accomplish site closure.
Submit initial written, electronic, and intake reports to regulatory agencies.
Manage proper disposal of all waste.
Audit all subcontractor work orders/invoices for accuracy.
Input correct information into the ALERT system, including use of correct grammar and spelling, accurate selection of all appropriate categories, and addition of any notes or comments pertinent to the contact and/or contact record.
Providing and maintaining excellent customer service and satisfaction.
Ensure all DOT, OSHA, safety rules, regulations, guidelines, policies, and site-specific safety plans are following throughout cleanup activities.
Ensure that all client SOP’s and special instructions are performed and are compliant.
Communicate effectively to contractors, clients, regulatory officials, etc.…, through both written and verbal communication.
Return all internal and external calls, emails, and facsimiles in a timely manner to ensure that client concerns are understood, addressed and resolved in an efficient and complete manner as possible.
Maintains professional competency in all aspects of the job.
Relays emergency and non-emergency information to personnel in the field along with feedback on contractor.
Perform other job-related duties as required.
When necessary, answers a multi-line telephone system for emergency and non-emergency calls for clients, screen, and transfers calls, in a high-volume phone environment.
When necessary, complete phone screenings and assist clients in obtaining needed paperwork, SDS, from other providers and facilities.
Report to Sr Mgt any items of concern as relates to client or contractors’ expectations
Efficiently log “Billable Time” on a daily basis, in accordance with company guidelines and activities completed

Qualifications

3 to 5 years' experience or alternative combinations of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
Valid Driver's License
Leadership and supervisory skills
Excellent communication skills
Excellent presentation skills
Knowledge of scoping/pricing of Field Service work
Knowledge of equipment, environmental regulations/statutes, safety and compliance
Field service operations experience
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Windows based applications

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Project Manager
jobs.description:
Conquest Planning is a leading financial planning software company with a purpose-driven approach to delivering financial advice. Established in 2018, Conquest Planning was founded by a team of financial technology veterans whose track record of success spans over 30 years in the financial planning software space. The company’s mission is to ensure that everyone has access to great financial advice, transforming the financial planning landscape and improving outcomes for all clients. Users of Conquest Planning leverage its intuitively designed product, simple onboarding process, and data-driven artificial intelligence to accelerate the delivery of beautifully designed, hyper-personalized financial plans. We are based out of Winnipeg, Manitoba and have team members located across Canada, the United States, and United Kingdom.

We are seeking a Senior Delivery Project Manager to join our dynamic team!

The Senior Delivery Project Manager is accountable and owns project delivery at Conquest Planning. Being an accountable ownership role, the Project Manager takes a project from the moment scope is handed off through to production, closure, and retrospective — and is answerable for how it runs, how it is governed, how it is reported, and when it deploys for the client.

The Senior Delivery Project Manager sets the direction for the project. They define how the project will be governed, convert high-level scope into a client-facing Statement of Work, call for the solutioning resources the work demands, drive milestones and dependencies to closure, and own the truth of status — internally and externally. When a project is at risk, the Senior Delivery Project Manager owns the recovery plan, not just the escalation.

This role runs multiple concurrent projects across Conquest’s delivery engagements, applying best practices in project governance and change management. The Senior Delivery Project Manager is a highly organized, detail-oriented leader who is trusted to make decisions, hold internal and external stakeholders to commitments, and deliver Conquest solutions into client environments with a high standard of quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

This is a remote / work from home opportunity.

Duties Of The Role Include

The Senior Project Manager is the single accountable owner for the following, end to end:

End-to-end ownership. The project runs from initiation to production and closure under the Project Manager's ownership.
Governance definition. A detailed project charter is authored up front, establishing how projects will be governed.
Define within the charter: objectives and success criteria, scope boundaries, governance and decision rights, escalation paths, meeting and reporting cadence, roles and responsibilities, assumptions, constraints, and change control.
Secure alignment and sign-off on the charter from internal leadership and the client before execution begins, so that governance is agreed rather than improvised.
Maintain the charter as the governing reference for the life of the program, updating it through formal change control as the program evolves.

Statement of Work. High-level scope from the Sales Engineer and Solutions Consultant is converted into a Statement of Work and submitted to the external client.
Define deliverables, milestones, timelines, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and client responsibilities with enough precision to hold up through delivery.
Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate feasibility ad effort before the SOW is issued.
Present the SOW to the client, resolve questions, and drive it to client acceptance.
Own change control against the SOW: identify scope change as it emerges, quantify its impact, and manage it formally rather than absorbing it silently.

Resourcing advocacy. Solutioning resource needs are identified early and escalated with a clear case for what is required and why.
Assess the skills, capacity, and specialist solutioning support each project requires, and surface those needs early.
Make the case for solutioning resources with clear justification: what is needed, when, for how long, and what the consequence is if it is not provided.
Partner with the VP Global Delivery to secure the right people at the right time, and flag contention across concurrent projects.
Continuously monitor whether the resourcing in place still matches the work, and re-raise the need as scope, complexity, or timelines shift.

Execution control. Milestones, dependencies, blockers, action items, and change requests are tracked and driven to closure throughout the program. Partner with Solution Consultants who are responsible for requirements while retaining accountability for the project plan itself.
Author and own the status report for every assigned program, for both internal leadership and the external client.
Report accurately and candidly: progress against plan, upcoming milestones, risks and issues with owners and mitigations, decisions required, and changes to scope, schedule, or cost.
Set and hold a predictable reporting cadence so stakeholders are never guessing at program health.
Facilitate effective communication across technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Escalate to senior leadership early and with a recommendation attached, not simply a problem statement.
Act as the primary liaison between internal product leaders, development teams, and the client.
Build and nurture trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to foster collaboration and long-term success.

Status reporting. Internal and external status reporting is authored and owned by the Project Manager.
Hold all parties accountable to agreed commitments, dates, and quality standards.
Own the decision path for the project: escalate what genuinely requires senior input, and decide what does not.
Act as the hub of communication and accountability across clients, internal teams, and stakeholders — the person who knows the state of the project at all times.

Closure. The program is formally closed once delivered into production.
Confirm all deliverables are complete and accepted, all acceptance criteria are met, and all open items are resolved or formally transferred with a named owner.
Secure client sign-off and confirm the transition to production support, ensuring the receiving team has what it needs
Finalize and archive comprehensive project documentation, including plans, workflows, decisions, risks, changes, and lessons learned.

Retrospective. A retrospective is conducted, documented, and converted into actions that improve future projects.
Champion continuous improvement across project governance and seek efficiencies.

Portfolio management. Multiple concurrent projects are owned and balanced without loss of quality or visibility.
Maintain consistent governance, documentation, and reporting standards across every project, so quality does not vary with volume.
Recognize and raise cross-project dependencies, resource contention, and cumulative risk that would not be visible from any single project.

Qualifications Required

5-10 years of PM experience
Demonstrated ownership of complex delivery projects end to end, in a client-facing environment.
Proven ability to author project charters, Statements of Work, and executive-level status reporting.
Strong command of Agile, software development lifecycles, and change management practices.
Hands-on proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for program planning, tracking, and reporting.
Confidence holding internal and external stakeholders accountable to commitments, with credibility rather than escalation.
Clear, direct communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort owning several concurrent projects without losing rigour.
Current awareness of trends in FinTech, program management methodologies, and software delivery best practices.

How Success Is Measured

Projects delivered on schedule, in scope, and to defined quality standards.
Every project governed by an agreed charter and an accepted Statement of Work.
Risks and blockers raised early, with mitigation owned and resolved before they affect commitments.
Status reporting delivered on cadence, accurate, and trusted by internal leadership and clients alike.
Projects formally closed with client sign-off and a clean transition to production BAU.
Retrospectives completed for every project, with improvement actions owned and implemented.
Client satisfaction sustained across a portfolio of concurrent projects.

What To Expect

An inclusive culture comprised of extremely talented individuals.
A leadership team with a proven track record of success.
The opportunity to join a company as it expands across the globe.
Competitive compensation and generous benefits.

Next Steps

If this exciting opportunity is of interest to you, please apply to the Senior Delivery Project Manager
job posting via the Bamboo link below.

https://conquestplanning.bamboohr.com/careers/27

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those invited for an interview will be contacted.

Conquest Planning Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive work environment welcomes diversity and supports accessibility. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please contact human.resources@conquestplanning.com.

Overview

Remote Project Manager – Kitchen & Bath Remodeling

Kitchen Tune-Up & Bath Tune-Up

Remote Position Supporting North Atlanta, Georgia Projects

Performance-based bonuses
Long-term career advancement opportunities
Remote work
Opportunity to grow with an expanding remodeling company

Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

Kitchen Tune-Up and Bath Tune-Up is seeking an experienced Remote Project Manager
to coordinate residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects throughout North Atlanta.

This is a full-time remote position for someone who can successfully coordinate 10-20 active remodeling projects simultaneously
while maintaining exceptional standards for scheduling, client communication, documentation, material ordering, quality control, project cycle times, and budget performance.

Our goal is straightforward: Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

The right candidate has strong experience managing U.S. residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects. They are highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable holding installers and trade partners accountable, and committed to doing things the right way—even when no one is watching.

Compensation

$12 per hour
50 hours per week
Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results, including:
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
On-time project completion and cycle times
Budget and gross-margin performance
Accurate and timely material ordering
Project documentation and communication
Minimal delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty issues

Opportunity for increased responsibility and career advancement based on performance

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Operations Manager and remotely coordinate multiple residential remodeling projects from pre-construction preparation through final completion.

Project Management and Scheduling

Coordinate 10-20 active kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects simultaneously
Review project scopes, plans, measurements, selections, specifications, budgets, and schedules before construction begins
Confirm that field measurements and site conditions have been properly documented before materials are ordered
Develop, maintain, and update realistic project schedules
Coordinate installers, trade partners, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and homeowners
Confirm daily installer attendance, progress, and next steps
Identify potential delays, missing materials, or cost overruns early and develop corrective action plans
Keep projects moving efficiently while minimizing downtime between construction phases
Ensure work remains within the approved scope and budget
Track pre-construction walks, start dates, countertop templating, installations, inspections, final walkthroughs, punch lists, completion dates, and outside dates
Protect project gross margin by actively managing labor, materials, change orders, rework, and scheduling

Material Ordering and Production Coordination

Review approved proposals, plans, selections, and measurements before ordering
Prepare and maintain detailed material lists and project-ordering trackers
Coordinate the ordering of cabinetry, cabinet-refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, hardware, lighting, and related products
Confirm order acknowledgments, lead times, delivery dates, quantities, specifications, and finishes
Track whether materials have been ordered, received, inspected, and assigned to the correct project
Communicate proactively regarding backorders, damaged products, missing materials, and substitutions
Coordinate deliveries with vendors, Field Supervisors, installers, and clients
Help prevent ordering errors, jobsite delays, duplicate purchases, and unnecessary expedited-shipping costs

Quality Control and Documentation

Review daily jobsite photographs, videos, installer reports, and project updates
Confirm that completed work appears consistent with the approved scope, plans, selections, and Kitchen Tune-Up standards
Escalate potential quality concerns to the Field Supervisor or Operations Manager immediately
Maintain accurate project notes, schedules, photographs, documents, and communications in company systems
Track open items, deficiencies, punch-list work, callbacks, and warranty issues through completion
Help reduce rework by identifying inconsistencies, missing information, and potential problems early
Confirm that every project has complete and organized documentation

Client Experience

Provide homeowners with timely and professional project updates
Set clear expectations regarding schedules, upcoming work, required decisions, deliveries, and project milestones
Communicate proactively—especially when challenges, changes, or delays arise
Respond promptly and professionally to client questions and concerns
Coordinate project walkthroughs and ensure punch-list items are documented and resolved
Help create Raving Fans who confidently recommend Kitchen Tune-Up and leave 5-star Google reviews

Installer, Trade Partner, and Team Coordination

Build productive working relationships with installers, trade partners, vendors, and internal team members
Communicate daily with field personnel regarding attendance, progress, materials, quality, and upcoming work
Hold installers and trade partners accountable for schedules, communication, documentation, and commitments
Confirm that installers submit required jobsite photographs, videos, time records, and daily reports
Communicate project risks, delays, client concerns, and resource needs to the Operations Manager
Participate in daily project huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls
Prepare clear meeting notes, action items, deadlines, and follow-up communications
Follow through until every assigned task and project issue is fully resolved

Budget and Change-Order Management

Monitor project budgets, labor costs, material expenses, and gross-margin performance
Compare proposed work with actual field conditions and client requests
Identify work that falls outside the approved proposal
Prepare change-order information for management review before additional work begins
Track approved change orders and confirm that they are incorporated into schedules and project documentation
Help prevent unauthorized work, unapproved material purchases, and avoidable cost overruns

What Success Looks Like

The Remote Project Manager will be evaluated on their ability to help us Create Raving Fans & Make Money
, including:

Projects completed on schedule
Accurate and continuously updated project schedules
Projects completed within budget and gross-profit targets
Timely and accurate material ordering
Minimal ordering mistakes, delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty claims
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
Proactive client and team communication
Complete and accurate project documentation
Installer and trade-partner accountability
Fast identification and resolution of project risks
Ability to manage 10-20 active projects without sacrificing quality, client care, or profitability
Consistent ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through

Qualifications

Required

At least 3 years of project-management experience involving U.S. residential construction or remodeling
Direct experience managing kitchen, bathroom, cabinetry, or residential renovation projects
Demonstrated ability to coordinate more than five active projects simultaneously
Strong knowledge of U.S. residential construction methods, terminology, and sequencing
Working knowledge of cabinetry, countertops, tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, and finish carpentry
Experience reviewing plans, measurements, scopes of work, specifications, and product documentation
Experience coordinating materials, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and project schedules
Strong understanding of quality control, job costing, change orders, and gross-margin management
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners, installers, vendors, and team members
Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly
Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, headset, webcam, and distraction-free home workspace
Ability to remain available and responsive throughout scheduled working hours
Three professional supervisor references

Preferred

Experience with high-end residential remodeling
Experience working remotely for a U.S. construction or remodeling company
Experience with Buildertrend, ServiceMinder, 2020 Design, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, Zoom, or comparable systems
Experience ordering cabinetry, refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, and remodeling products
Experience managing more than 10 active remodeling projects simultaneously
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills
Relevant construction, design, estimating, or project-management education or certifications

Schedule

Full-time: 50 hours per week
Monday through Saturday
Must be available during the company’s required working hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
Attendance at daily huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls is required
Occasional evening availability may be required based on client or project needs
This is a remote position, but it requires consistent availability, professional communication, and active engagement throughout the workday

Who Thrives Here

You May Be a Strong Fit If You:

Take complete ownership and follow through
Hold yourself and others accountable at an A-player level
Notice details others miss
Communicate problems early instead of allowing surprises
Respond promptly and understand that radio silence is unacceptable
Respect clients, teammates, installers, trade partners, and their time
Remain calm, resourceful, and solutions-focused under pressure
Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
Understand that excellent client service and profitable operations go hand in hand
Always strive to do the right thing
Want to build a long-term career with a growing remodeling company

About Kitchen Tune-Up

Kitchen Tune-Up provides kitchen remodeling and improvement solutions designed to transform clients’ homes while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We believe remodeling should improve both the beauty of a home and the lives of the people who live there. We combine thoughtful planning, excellent craftsmanship, proactive communication, and disciplined project management to deliver outstanding results.

Our Operating Principles

Client Experience: Treat every homeowner and home with care, honesty, and respect.
Quality: Deliver craftsmanship we are proud to stand behind.
Ownership: Take responsibility for results and solve problems proactively.
Communication: Keep clients and teammates informed—no surprises and no radio silence.
Discipline: Protect schedules, budgets, margins, and company resources.
Continuous Improvement: Learn from every project and continuously improve our systems.
Purpose & Profit: Create Raving Fans & Make Money! Create exceptional value for clients while building a profitable, strong, and sustainable business.

Apply Today

Please Submit:

Your résumé
A brief summary of your U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling experience
A list of the project-management and construction software you have used
Your internet speed and home-office setup
Three professional supervisor references

Qualified applicants should be prepared to discuss specific projects they have managed, the number of simultaneous projects they coordinated, and examples of how they protected schedules, budgets, quality, and client relationships.

This role will serve as a deputy and trusted right hand to the Sr Program Manager, helping lead day-to-day contract operations, client delivery, workforce management, technical execution, and strategic growth. The successful candidate will independently lead major aspects of the program, maintain visibility across multiple projects and workstreams, supervise and develop staff, anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, and step in for program leadership as needed. This individual must be comfortable operating with limited direction, bringing structure to ambiguity, making sound decisions, and moving seamlessly between client engagement, team leadership, internal operations, technical delivery, and business strategy.

A significant part of this role is people leadership. The Program Manager will supervise employees across different roles, disciplines, levels of seniority, and career stages. The successful candidate must be comfortable setting clear expectations, coaching and developing employees, recognizing strong performance, addressing performance or behavioral concerns directly, and having difficult conversations when necessary.

The ideal candidate brings strong federal program management experience, operational discipline, business acumen, and an interest in helping grow LMI’s VA portfolio. Experience with Agile delivery and familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint development, and/or program evaluation is strongly preferred. Prior experience supporting VA is a significant advantage.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Serve as a deputy to the Sr Program Manager, providing leadership across contract operations, client delivery, staffing, financial performance, and strategic priorities.
Independently lead program activities and represent program leadership with clients, internal stakeholders, and delivery teams as needed.
Directly supervise and manage employees across different job families, technical disciplines, titles, experience levels, and levels of seniority.
Set clear performance expectations, provide ongoing feedback and coaching, support professional development, and hold employees accountable for performance, behavior, and delivery commitments.
Lead LMI’s Performance 365 process for assigned staff, including goal setting, ongoing performance discussions, career development, recognition, documentation, and formal performance reviews.
Address performance concerns early and directly, including conducting difficult or sensitive conversations, establishing improvement expectations, documenting issues appropriately, and partnering with leadership and HR when necessary.
Plan, coordinate, and oversee execution across multiple concurrent projects and workstreams, ensuring priorities, resources, risks, and outcomes remain aligned.
Establish and maintain effective program operating rhythms, governance, schedules, action tracking, decision logs, and performance reporting.
Monitor cost, schedule, scope, staffing, utilization, and performance, identifying emerging issues and recommending corrective actions.
Support program financial management, including forecasting, budget monitoring, labor planning, variance analysis, and monthly reporting.
Lead workforce planning activities, including staffing strategy, recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, resource allocation, and performance oversight.
Build and sustain trusted relationships with VA stakeholders, program leadership, technical teams, partners, and LMI leadership.
Translate evolving client priorities into actionable requirements, work plans, deliverables, and resource needs.
Lead and support Agile delivery using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid approaches, including backlog management, prioritization, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
Use Jira, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, dashboards, and related tools to maintain visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery performance.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams that may include developers, analysts, data scientists, evaluators, technical leads, and subject matter experts.
Partner with technical teams delivering solutions involving Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, analytics, data, workflow automation, and program evaluation.
Proactively identify and resolve operational, technical, staffing, client, and delivery risks before they affect program performance.
Develop executive briefings, program reviews, status reports, dashboards, recommendations, and decision materials for VA and LMI leadership.
Facilitate client and internal leadership meetings, drive decisions, assign accountability, and ensure follow-through.
Ensure program activities and deliverables meet applicable contractual, VA, federal, security, privacy, and LMI requirements.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve program operations, delivery processes, team effectiveness, and client outcomes.
Support account strategy and organic growth by identifying emerging client priorities, unmet needs, and opportunities for expanded LMI support.
Contribute to business development, capture, proposals, solution development, and strategic planning, including shaping approaches, developing content, coordinating technical expertise, and supporting client presentations.
Connect client needs with capabilities across LMI to develop integrated solutions and strengthen the broader VA account.
Mentor project managers and team leads, helping strengthen delivery discipline and develop future program leadership capability.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, management, public administration, health administration, information systems, technology, public health, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in program management, project management, operations, consulting, technology delivery, federal contracting, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience serving in a deputy program manager, senior project manager, program operations lead, or comparable leadership capacity.
Demonstrated people-management experience, including direct supervision of employees across multiple roles, disciplines, or levels of seniority.
Experience establishing performance expectations, coaching employees, supporting career development, recognizing strong performance, and addressing performance or conduct issues.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to have direct, constructive, and sometimes difficult conversations with employees and leaders when accountability, performance, behavior, or delivery expectations are not being met.
Experience managing formal performance-management processes; familiarity with Performance 365 or similar continuous performance-management approaches is preferred.
Ability to lead effectively in a matrixed environment, influence without direct authority, align individuals with competing priorities, and create accountability across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, schedules, risks, and stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid approaches.
Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery-management tools.
Familiarity with one or more of the following:
Microsoft Power Platform;
SharePoint development or modernization;
Program evaluation, performance measurement, analytics, or data-informed decision support.

Strong operational, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and lead with minimal direction.
Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level briefings and recommendations.
Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Demonstrated experience in business development, capture, proposal development, client growth, or account strategy.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Desired Qualfications

Prior experience supporting the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, particularly VHA or VA central-office programs.
Experience in suicide prevention, mental health, behavioral health, healthcare, public health, or Veteran services.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, program evaluation, analytics, or digital modernization.
Experience managing multidisciplinary technical and analytical teams.
Federal contract operations experience, including staffing, financial management, forecasting, and deliverable management.
Experience supporting business development, capture, proposals, solutioning, or organic account growth.
PMP, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, Microsoft, or related certifications.

Target salary range: $140,000-$160,000

jobs.title: Security GRC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Sakana AIでは、自然界から発想を得るユニークな生成AI技術により、世界に先駆ける研究開発を行っています。

Security GRC Program Managerは、Sakana AIの従業員やサービスを提供するためのシステムに対してセキュリティリスクを低減するためのガバナンス・コンプライアンスを確立する役割を担います。 プロジェクトチーム、プロダクトチーム、法務等の各チームと連携し、事業に関連する法令・規制の遵守、SOC2やISMS等のセキュリティ認証において必要となるセキュリティリスク管理体制やリスク評価プロセスの確立、監査対応等を推進します。

本ポジションは、日本を拠点とし、日本語でのビジネスレベルの会話および英語の業務文書を理解・推敲する能力が求められます。

役割と責任

本ポジションは、以下の領域を各チームと連携して担います（各領域の末尾は対応するセキュリティ人材フレームワーク役割）。
1. セキュリティガバナンス・戦略
セキュリティ戦略・ポリシー・規程の策定、およびCISO／経営層の補佐
法令・規制、セキュリティ認証等の要求事項や顧客からのセキュリティ要求の理解と、技術的実態に基づくリスクベースでの対策レベルの決定
セキュリティ対策に必要なリソース（予算・体制）確保の支援、外部委託・サプライチェーンのセキュリティ統括

2. セキュリティプログラム／プロジェクト推進
セキュリティリスクマネジメントプロセスの確立・改善、およびセキュリティリスク対応計画の策定
ISMS運営や全社展開等、セキュリティ対策に関するプログラム／プロジェクトの推進・管理（計画・進捗・予算・委託先管理）
個人情報・機密情報の管理・運用ルールの整備

3. コンプライアンス・法務対応
個人情報保護（GDPR／CBPR等）やサイバー・デジタル関連の法令・規制への対応を、法務と連携してセキュリティ要件へ翻訳・推進
法的リスクの分析・評価（プライバシー影響評価（PIA）等）、および規程等の社内ドキュメントの作成・改訂

4. 認証取得・監査対応
SOC2やISMS等のセキュリティ認証の取得・維持
リスクアセスメントおよび内部監査の計画・実施、監査結果に基づく改善計画の策定・フォローアップ
顧客等からの外部監査への対応
リスク評価・監査対応（証跡収集・統制モニタリング）の自動化・効率化（Vanta/Drata等 ＋ スクリプトの活用）

5. セキュリティ教育・訓練
従業員に対するセキュリティ教育やセキュリティ訓練の企画・実施・評価、および啓発コンテンツの作成

応募資格およびスキル (Must)

次のいずれかの知識・実務経験を有している
サイバーセキュリティコンサルティングに関する実務経験を有している
SOC2やISMS等のセキュリティ認証の取得および維持に関する実務経験を有している
セキュリティリスクマネジメント／リスクアセスメントの確立・運用に関する実務経験を有している
情報セキュリティ監査またはシステム監査に関する実務経験を有している
GDPRやCBPR等の個人情報保護に関する法令・規制への対応に関する実務経験を有している
金融機関や官公庁のセキュリティ要件への対応に関する実務経験を有している（例：FISC安全対策基準やISMAP等）
従業員に対するセキュリティ教育・訓練の企画・実施・運用に関する実務経験を有している

上記に加えて、次の要件を満たしている
クラウド／システムに関する技術的理解を有し、エンジニア（SWE・Cybersecurity Engineer）と同じ目線で、統制の実装可否や技術的リスクを議論・遂行できる（机上のポリシー策定に留まらず、自ら手を動かして統制を実装・検証できる）
優れた文章力と口頭でのコミュニケーション能力を持ち、技術的な問題を技術者と非技術者の両方に分かりやすく説明できる
部門横断プロジェクト管理に長けており、影響力、組織力、徹底したフォローアップを通じて、イニシアチブを推進することができる
ベンダー管理、資産管理、調達、および組織におけるテクノロジー運用を高い実行力と細部への注意力をもって管理できる
ビジネスレベルの日本語力（JLPT N1レベル）

歓迎要件（Nice to Have）

Webアプリケーション開発に関する技術的な専門知識を有している
Google Cloud等のパブリッククラウドのセキュリティコントロール実装に関する技術的な専門知識を有している
脆弱性診断やペネトレーションテスト等、技術的なセキュリティ評価の実務経験を有している
VantaやDrata等のコンプライアンス管理プラットフォームの導入・運用、および証跡収集・統制モニタリングの自動化に関する実務経験を有している
AIを活用した製品・サービス開発に関する実務経験を有している
AISM（AI Security Management）の取得および維持に関する実務経験を有している
内部統制（J-SOX）に関連するIT統制の実装と運用に関する実務経験を有している
後輩社員の育成や経営幹部のサポートに関する実務経験を有している
ビジネスレベルの英語力

Benefits

社会保険完備（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険）
完全週休二日制（土・日）、国民の祝日、年末年始休暇（12/30〜1/3）
年次有給休暇
慶弔休暇、生理休暇
産前産後休暇、育児休業、介護休業
フレックスタイム制 / 裁量労働制（職種による）
ハイブリッド勤務（オフィス＋リモート）
通勤手当支給

jobs.title: TMT Program Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager
whose experience focuses on client development and delivery of data center projects. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully delivering various data center and mission critical projects ranging from upfront planning and pre-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive TMT (Tech, Media and Telecom) practices in the industry. In additional to managing and delivery projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Primary Responsibilities:

In the role of TMT Program Manager
, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary tech media & telecom (TMT) programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.
This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making.
Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Align and communicate with operations and market sector planning for resources, goals, and area growth in the region as they relate to the program needs you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Align, communicate, and mentor project managers within the program you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client’s site temporarily
US Citizen

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Maritime Defense Technology
jobs.description:
About Pole Star Defense:

Pole Star Defense is a leading provider of maritime domain awareness, maritime security, and fisheries monitoring systems to the government sector. Since 1998, we have pushed the limits of innovation, mitigating growing threats to ships, supply chains, cargo, territorial waters and, most importantly, safety of lives at sea and beyond. Today, we continue to develop and implement pioneering intelligence technologies to protect customer vessels, people, maritime domain, and reputation.

The Opportunity:

Pole Star Defense is seeking a Senior Project Manager to independently execute federal programs within our PMO. This role bridges two disciplines, requiring equal depth in federal compliance (ATO coordination, government reporting, and deliverable tracking) and Agile execution (sprint cadences and backlog management). Beyond program delivery, you will help scale the PMO by establishing organizational standards, planning templates, and handoff procedures.

The ideal candidate brings proven experience in federal government contracting, Agile methodologies, and excels at managing internal and external stakeholder relationships. We are seeking a proactive leader who will take the initiative to mature our PMO processes.

Responsibilities:

Program Delivery

Own program delivery, milestone tracking, critical path analysis, and contract timelines (periods of performance, modifications, and option exercises.
Maintain the risk register to proactively resolve issues and shield delivery teams from requirements volatility
Monitor program budgets, burn rates, and resource allocation in coordination with Finance.
Coordinate delivery across multiple internal departments without direct organizational authority

Backlog, Priorities, and Agile Delivery

Shape and sequence the backlog to ensure sprint content and workflows align directly with contract commitments.
Partner with product and engineering to translate customer intent into prioritized user stories with explicit acceptance criteria.
Participate in sprint ceremonies to provide engineering teams with critical contract and customer context
Leverage velocity and throughput metrics to predict timelines, manage scope creep, and inform customer reporting.

Government Customer Interface

Act as the daily PMO point of contact for the government program office to deliver status updates, release timelines, and risk disclosures.
Manage the Authority to Operate (ATO) lifecycle with InfoSec and the customer’s ISSO, including artifacts and continuous monitoring.
Manage incoming customer requests, translate them into internal work packages, and prevent unauthorized scope creep.

PMO Standards and Function Building

Author and improve scalable PMO standards, templates, intake procedures, and program handoff documentation.
Maintain project plans, schedules, and compliance documentation under strict version control in the PMO repository.
Contribute program and past-performance content to proposals and RFP responses.

Required Skills:

6+ years of tech/software project management experience; 3+ years supporting federal government contracts and program offices.
Deep Agile/Scrum fluency (as PM, PO, or Scrum Master) with a proven track record of managing backlogs, sequencing work, and balancing sprint flexibility with fixed contract deadlines.
Demonstrated end-to-end program ownership, including independently managing schedules, risk registers, and fluid customer relationships.
Knowledge of federal contract mechanics (mods, PoP) and security compliance workstreams (ATO/RMF).
Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills to brief both technical teams and government stakeholders.
Mastery of project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or MS Project

Additional Skills:

Experience with FedRAMP or DoD Impact Level (IL2 through IL4) cloud environments from a delivery or compliance coordination perspective
Familiarity with both front-end and back-end software development and an understanding of cloud architecture (AWS)
Related experience in the maritime technology industry

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor’s in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience.
PMP or PgMP certification
Agile certification such as CSM, PSM, or CSPO, or any other related certification

Employee Benefits:

Pole Star offers benefits that are designed to lead an evolving marketplace and

encourage a healthy balance between work and life. Highlights of those benefits are listed below:

Medical insurance for employees and their dependents (Premiums are 100% covered by the Company)
Dental and Vision insurance for employees and their dependents (Premiums are 50% covered by the Company)
Life and Disability insurance, Company funded
20 days annual leave
5 days of Wellbeing leave
Up to a 5% 401k matching
Gym membership subsidy
PTO for Volunteer Day
Refer-a-friend recruitment bonus

Work Schedule Note:

While this position is scheduled for a traditional Monday – Friday work week, our systems run 24/7/365 and as such, you may be expected to perform out of hours, on-call support on an as needed basis. Additional compensation may be available for working on-call, on standby, or during holiday hours.

This is a Public Trust position and requires completion of a State and Federal Criminal History Report (i.e., background check) as well as an FBI Summary History Report. Current and future employment will be contingent upon satisfactory completion of both the Criminal History Report and the FBI Summary History Report.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Health Careers Training
jobs.description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

The Senior Project Manager, Health Careers Training supports the implementation and growth of the EMK-MGB Health Careers Training Partnership, a nationally recognized collaboration between Mass General Brigham (MGB), Edward M. Kennedy Academy for Health Careers (EMK), Boston Public Schools, the City of Boston, Bloomberg Philanthropies, and Bunker Hill Community College. The partnership is designed to create accessible and supportive pathways into healthcare careers for Boston students while helping address critical workforce needs across the healthcare industry.

This role is responsible for coordinating and managing career-connected learning opportunities that introduce students to healthcare careers, deepen engagement with clinical environments, and build progressive pathways from exploration to employment. The Senior Project Manager serves as a key liaison between EMK school staff, MGB clinical teams, community health programs, MGB Youth Programs and Summer Jobs, workforce development partners, and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of partnership initiatives.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, relationship-oriented, and passionate about educational and workforce opportunity. They excel at managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, thrive in dynamic environments, and are excited by the opportunity to help build innovative pathways that connect young people to meaningful careers in healthcare.

**This role will be hybrid with on-site presence at EMK and/or MGB sites 2-4 days a week depending on programming for the week. **

Program Planning & Implementation

Lead the planning and execution of 9th and 10th grade healthcare career exploration programming, including career days, hospital visits, simulations, speaker events, and clinical department engagement.
Manage all logistics for school-year and summer healthcare learning experiences, including scheduling, transportation, curriculum alignment, volunteer coordination, student supervision, and day-of operations.
Coordinate MGB's participation in the EMK Huskies Summer Bridge Program, including hospital-based career exploration and simulation experiences for rising 9th graders.
Partner with EMK staff to align programming with Career and Technical Education (CTE) curriculum, student learning objectives, and long-term partnership goals.
Coordinate financial and administrative logistics for partnership programming, including ordering supplies, arranging catering and other program-related purchases, tracking expenditures, and working with MGB Finance to secure required approvals and ensure compliance with organizational policies and funding requirements.

Clinical Partnerships & Student Pathways

Build and maintain relationships with clinical leaders and staff across MGB to support career exploration, work-based learning, and workforce pipeline initiatives.
Partner with MGB Youth Programs to expand internship access, support student success, and strengthen pathways from internships to employment.
Develop and coordinate advanced experiences for 11th and 12th grade students, including certification-aligned clinical hours, practicums, job shadowing, and other work-based learning opportunities.
Collaborate with EMK and higher education partners to create clear educational and career pathway resources connecting EMK CTE programs to advanced healthcare careers.

Community Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

Manage community-based partnerships that support EMK students and families, including the YMCA Mobile Market, Community Care Van, ThriveLink, and other health and wellness initiatives.
Serve as MGB's primary liaison for the Big Brothers Big Sisters mentoring partnership, supporting mentor recruitment, coordination, and student engagement.
Facilitate collaboration across Community Health, Workforce Development, Youth Programs, Talent Acquisition, and clinical departments to maximize partnership impact.

Advisory Committee & Leadership Engagement

Coordinate the EMK-MGB Advisory Committee, including meeting planning, stakeholder communications, agenda development, materials preparation, and follow-up activities.
Engage advisory committee members to identify and advance new clinical partnerships, mentoring opportunities, career pathways, and program enhancements.
Develop regular updates and presentations for partnership stakeholders, senior leaders, and key partners.

Communications & Storytelling

Develop public-facing communications that promote partnership impact, healthcare career pathways, and volunteer engagement opportunities.
Partner with MGB Communications, Community Health, and EMK leadership to create social media content, newsletter articles, intranet stories, presentations, and other partnership materials.
Prepare communications and presentations for funders, executive leaders, community stakeholders, and external convenings.

Data Management, Evaluation & Reporting

Maintain project plans, implementation timelines, participation data, and partnership performance metrics.
Collect, analyze, and report program outcomes to support continuous improvement, strategic decision-making, and impact measurement.
Prepare grant reports, funding updates, budget tracking materials, and performance reports for leadership and funders.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve student experiences, partnership effectiveness, and workforce outcomes through data, stakeholder feedback, and emerging best practices.
Stay informed on healthcare workforce trends, youth development strategies, and career-connected learning models to strengthen and expand partnership programming.

Note: This is a grant-funded role with funding committed through June 2029. MGB’s intent is to turn this into a permanent role once return on investment is realized from hiring EMK graduates and/or additional philanthropic funding is raised.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Education, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
5-8 years of experience in project management, education, workforce development, healthcare operations, community engagement, program management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience working with K-12 education, workforce development, youth programming, healthcare organizations, or community partnerships strongly preferred.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to engage effectively with students, educators, clinicians, administrators, and community partners.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation development and facilitation.
Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting program outcomes and performance metrics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management/data tracking systems.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across interdisciplinary teams.
Commitment to advancing educational opportunity, workforce equity, and healthcare career pathways.

Working Conditions

Hybrid position with regular onsite presence at both EMK and MGB locations (2-4 days/week)
Frequent travel between EMK, MGH, BWH, and other MGB sites in Greater Boston required
Occasional evening or weekend availability required for student events, community activities, and partnership meetings
Ability to supervise student activities in school, hospital, and community settings

jobs.title: Program Manager (RSI Lab)
jobs.description:
プログラムマネージャー、RSI Lab
About RSI Lab
Sakana AI Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab は、AIの開発プロセスそのものを設計し直すことを担う専任の研究グループです。CEOのDavid Haと直接連携しながら、次のフロンティアAIのアーキテクチャを構築しています。RSI Labでは、とりわけ研究サイエンティストとソフトウェアエンジニアの二つのポジションを中心にチームを立ち上げています。

Role Overview
RSI Labの研究活動を支えるプログラムマネージャーを募集します。トップクラスの研究者・エンジニアが研究に専念できるよう、スケジュール管理・対外コミュニケーション・予算管理を含む研究オペレーション全般を担っていただきます。研究者と対等に技術的な会話ができる方と、社内外のステークホルダーを動かす実行力を兼ね備えた方を求めています。
What You Will Do
RSI Labの研究プロジェクトについて、スケジュール管理・進行管理・予算管理を担い、研究者が研究に専念できる体制を構築する
研究の進捗・成果を技術的に理解し、研究者と直接対話しながら計画と実態のギャップを把握・調整する
社外パートナーとの窓口業務を含む、対外コミュニケーションを担当する
研究チームの採用・オンボーディングに関わる社内プロセスを推進する
CEOおよびリーダーシップチームに対し、プロジェクトの状況を定期的に報告する

Who We Are Looking For
AI/ML分野の研究内容を理解し、リサーチャーと技術的な会話ができる方(自身での研究実施は必須ではありません)
国際的なチーム環境で、日本語・英語の両方を使って業務を進められる方(折衝・文書作成含む)
予算管理・プロジェクトマネジメント・対外折衝のいずれかの実務経験
複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な環境での調整経験がある方は歓迎

Note
本ロールは、Member of Technical Staff (RSI Lab)のような研究職ポジションとは異なり、研究を支えるプログラム運営を専門とする職種です。ご自身の技術的背景がリサーチャー職に合致する場合は、そちらのポジションもご検討ください。

About RSI Lab
The Sakana AI Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab is a dedicated research group within Sakana AI, tasked with redesigning the AI development process itself with AI. By transitioning from static, human-led R&D to autonomous, self-improving intelligence engines, we are turning constraints into our greatest compounding advantage. We are building the definitive architecture for the next frontier of AI. The Lab is actively scaling both research and engineering resources at our Tokyo headquarters, seeking exceptional, highly driven individuals to join us across two core profiles: Frontier Research Scientists and Advanced Core Engineers.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Program Manager to support the research operations of RSI Lab. As the Lab scales its research and engineering resources to engineer the next great leap in computational intelligence, this role covers budget management, schedule management, and external communications, ensuring our researchers and engineers can focus fully on research at maximum velocity. We’re looking for someone who can hold their own in technical conversations with researchers, while also driving execution across internal and external stakeholders.
What You Will Do
Own budget management, schedule management, and progress tracking across RSI Lab’s research projects, building a structure that lets researchers stay focused on research
Understand research progress and outcomes at a technical level, working directly with researchers to identify and close gaps between plan and reality
Serve as a point of contact for external partners, including relevant communications
Drive internal processes related to hiring and onboarding for the research team
Report project status regularly to the CEO and leadership team

Who We Are Looking For
Understands AI/ML research content well enough to have technical conversations with researchers (hands-on research experience not required)
Comfortable working collaboratively within an international team using both Japanese and English, including negotiation and document production in both languages
Experience in budget management, project management, or external negotiation
Experience coordinating in complex environments involving multiple stakeholders is a plus

Note
This role is distinct from research positions such as Member of Technical Staff (RSI Lab); it is focused on program operations that support research, not research itself. If your technical background aligns more with a research role, we encourage you to consider that position instead.
