new_jobs.title: Senior Delivery Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Conquest Planning is a leading financial planning software company with a purpose-driven approach to delivering financial advice. Established in 2018, Conquest Planning was founded by a team of financial technology veterans whose track record of success spans over 30 years in the financial planning software space. The company’s mission is to ensure that everyone has access to great financial advice, transforming the financial planning landscape and improving outcomes for all clients. Users of Conquest Planning leverage its intuitively designed product, simple onboarding process, and data-driven artificial intelligence to accelerate the delivery of beautifully designed, hyper-personalized financial plans. We are based out of Winnipeg, Manitoba and have team members located across Canada, the United States, and United Kingdom.

We are seeking a Senior Delivery Project Manager to join our dynamic team!

The Senior Delivery Project Manager is accountable and owns project delivery at Conquest Planning. Being an accountable ownership role, the Project Manager takes a project from the moment scope is handed off through to production, closure, and retrospective — and is answerable for how it runs, how it is governed, how it is reported, and when it deploys for the client.

The Senior Delivery Project Manager sets the direction for the project. They define how the project will be governed, convert high-level scope into a client-facing Statement of Work, call for the solutioning resources the work demands, drive milestones and dependencies to closure, and own the truth of status — internally and externally. When a project is at risk, the Senior Delivery Project Manager owns the recovery plan, not just the escalation.

This role runs multiple concurrent projects across Conquest’s delivery engagements, applying best practices in project governance and change management. The Senior Delivery Project Manager is a highly organized, detail-oriented leader who is trusted to make decisions, hold internal and external stakeholders to commitments, and deliver Conquest solutions into client environments with a high standard of quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

This is a remote / work from home opportunity.

Duties Of The Role Include

The Senior Project Manager is the single accountable owner for the following, end to end:

End-to-end ownership. The project runs from initiation to production and closure under the Project Manager's ownership.
Governance definition. A detailed project charter is authored up front, establishing how projects will be governed.
Define within the charter: objectives and success criteria, scope boundaries, governance and decision rights, escalation paths, meeting and reporting cadence, roles and responsibilities, assumptions, constraints, and change control.
Secure alignment and sign-off on the charter from internal leadership and the client before execution begins, so that governance is agreed rather than improvised.
Maintain the charter as the governing reference for the life of the program, updating it through formal change control as the program evolves.

Statement of Work. High-level scope from the Sales Engineer and Solutions Consultant is converted into a Statement of Work and submitted to the external client.
Define deliverables, milestones, timelines, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and client responsibilities with enough precision to hold up through delivery.
Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate feasibility ad effort before the SOW is issued.
Present the SOW to the client, resolve questions, and drive it to client acceptance.
Own change control against the SOW: identify scope change as it emerges, quantify its impact, and manage it formally rather than absorbing it silently.

Resourcing advocacy. Solutioning resource needs are identified early and escalated with a clear case for what is required and why.
Assess the skills, capacity, and specialist solutioning support each project requires, and surface those needs early.
Make the case for solutioning resources with clear justification: what is needed, when, for how long, and what the consequence is if it is not provided.
Partner with the VP Global Delivery to secure the right people at the right time, and flag contention across concurrent projects.
Continuously monitor whether the resourcing in place still matches the work, and re-raise the need as scope, complexity, or timelines shift.

Execution control. Milestones, dependencies, blockers, action items, and change requests are tracked and driven to closure throughout the program. Partner with Solution Consultants who are responsible for requirements while retaining accountability for the project plan itself.
Author and own the status report for every assigned program, for both internal leadership and the external client.
Report accurately and candidly: progress against plan, upcoming milestones, risks and issues with owners and mitigations, decisions required, and changes to scope, schedule, or cost.
Set and hold a predictable reporting cadence so stakeholders are never guessing at program health.
Facilitate effective communication across technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Escalate to senior leadership early and with a recommendation attached, not simply a problem statement.
Act as the primary liaison between internal product leaders, development teams, and the client.
Build and nurture trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to foster collaboration and long-term success.

Status reporting. Internal and external status reporting is authored and owned by the Project Manager.
Hold all parties accountable to agreed commitments, dates, and quality standards.
Own the decision path for the project: escalate what genuinely requires senior input, and decide what does not.
Act as the hub of communication and accountability across clients, internal teams, and stakeholders — the person who knows the state of the project at all times.

Closure. The program is formally closed once delivered into production.
Confirm all deliverables are complete and accepted, all acceptance criteria are met, and all open items are resolved or formally transferred with a named owner.
Secure client sign-off and confirm the transition to production support, ensuring the receiving team has what it needs
Finalize and archive comprehensive project documentation, including plans, workflows, decisions, risks, changes, and lessons learned.

Retrospective. A retrospective is conducted, documented, and converted into actions that improve future projects.
Champion continuous improvement across project governance and seek efficiencies.

Portfolio management. Multiple concurrent projects are owned and balanced without loss of quality or visibility.
Maintain consistent governance, documentation, and reporting standards across every project, so quality does not vary with volume.
Recognize and raise cross-project dependencies, resource contention, and cumulative risk that would not be visible from any single project.

Qualifications Required

5-10 years of PM experience
Demonstrated ownership of complex delivery projects end to end, in a client-facing environment.
Proven ability to author project charters, Statements of Work, and executive-level status reporting.
Strong command of Agile, software development lifecycles, and change management practices.
Hands-on proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for program planning, tracking, and reporting.
Confidence holding internal and external stakeholders accountable to commitments, with credibility rather than escalation.
Clear, direct communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort owning several concurrent projects without losing rigour.
Current awareness of trends in FinTech, program management methodologies, and software delivery best practices.

How Success Is Measured

Projects delivered on schedule, in scope, and to defined quality standards.
Every project governed by an agreed charter and an accepted Statement of Work.
Risks and blockers raised early, with mitigation owned and resolved before they affect commitments.
Status reporting delivered on cadence, accurate, and trusted by internal leadership and clients alike.
Projects formally closed with client sign-off and a clean transition to production BAU.
Retrospectives completed for every project, with improvement actions owned and implemented.
Client satisfaction sustained across a portfolio of concurrent projects.

What To Expect

An inclusive culture comprised of extremely talented individuals.
A leadership team with a proven track record of success.
The opportunity to join a company as it expands across the globe.
Competitive compensation and generous benefits.

Next Steps

job posting via the Bamboo link below.

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the leadership, planning, execution, and delivery of assigned Reactor Component projects and manufacturing work packages. The PM is accountable for achieving project objectives safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, technical, quality, and regulatory requirements.

This role provides leadership and integration across engineering, procurement, project controls, quality, manufacturing, supplier management, construction, and commercial functions to ensure effective project execution and customer satisfaction.

Your role

Project Delivery And Leadership

Lead the execution of assigned Reactor Component projects and equipment packages, including qualification, testing, procurement, manufacturing, inspection, and delivery activities.
Develop, maintain, and execute integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables to support successful project outcomes.
Establish and lead the project organization, including resource planning, staffing, performance management, and oversight of project team members.
Accountable for achieving project scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and contractual objectives.
Ensure equipment package readiness to support construction and site installation milestones.
Drive project execution in accordance with approved Project Execution Plans and company procedures.
Monitor project performance, including scope, schedule, cost, and key performance indicators, and provide regular status reporting to stakeholders and governance forums.
Apply sound project management practices to proactively manage risks, issues, resources, interfaces, and stakeholder expectations.

Engineering Integration

Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, and supplier activities to achieve project objectives.
Ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with project schedules and support procurement and manufacturing requirements.
Manage design and technical interfaces between suppliers, engineering teams, and plant systems.
Coordinate and facilitate the resolution of technical issues that impact project execution, manufacturing, procurement, or installation activities.

Procurement And Supplier Management

Support procurement strategy development, supplier qualification, and supplier selection activities.
Manage supplier performance throughout project execution to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality requirements, and delivery commitments.
Lead supplier progress reviews and maintain visibility of manufacturing schedules, key risks, and recovery plans.
Manage procurement activities, subcontractor scopes, and contract administration processes.
Support commercial negotiations, change management, claims avoidance, and contract management activities.

Manufacturing And Quality Oversight

Monitor fabrication and manufacturing activities through regular engagement with suppliers and manufacturing partners.
Ensure manufacturing activities align with integrated project schedules and critical path requirements.
Coordinate inspections, surveillance activities, manufacturing readiness reviews, and quality documentation requirements.
Identify and resolve issues affecting manufacturing performance, material availability, quality, or production schedules.
Ensure compliance with nuclear quality assurance programs, regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.

Stakeholder And Customer Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
Represent AtkinsRéalis in interactions with customers, suppliers, and project partners.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment and support effective decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Identify, assess, and manage project risks, opportunities, issues, and interface challenges, implementing mitigation and recovery plans as required.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives, operational excellence, and a strong nuclear safety culture.
Ensure compliance with corporate policies, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, the Nuclear Management System, and the Levels of Authority Policy.
Execute delegated authorities, including approvals for project changes, timesheets, overtime, procurement authorizations, and other assigned responsibilities.

About You

Minimum 8 years of experience managing or supporting complex engineering, manufacturing, procurement, construction, or capital projects.
Experience delivering projects within highly regulated industries, preferably nuclear, energy, aerospace, or similarly regulated sectors.

Project planning and execution.

セキュリティ戦略・ポリシー・規程の策定、およびCISO／経営層の補佐
法令・規制、セキュリティ認証等の要求事項や顧客からのセキュリティ要求の理解と、技術的実態に基づくリスクベースでの対策レベルの決定
セキュリティ対策に必要なリソース（予算・体制）確保の支援、外部委託・サプライチェーンのセキュリティ統括

2. セキュリティプログラム／プロジェクト推進
セキュリティリスクマネジメントプロセスの確立・改善、およびセキュリティリスク対応計画の策定
ISMS運営や全社展開等、セキュリティ対策に関するプログラム／プロジェクトの推進・管理（計画・進捗・予算・委託先管理）
個人情報・機密情報の管理・運用ルールの整備

3. コンプライアンス・法務対応
個人情報保護（GDPR／CBPR等）やサイバー・デジタル関連の法令・規制への対応を、法務と連携してセキュリティ要件へ翻訳・推進
法的リスクの分析・評価（プライバシー影響評価（PIA）等）、および規程等の社内ドキュメントの作成・改訂

4. 認証取得・監査対応
SOC2やISMS等のセキュリティ認証の取得・維持
リスクアセスメントおよび内部監査の計画・実施、監査結果に基づく改善計画の策定・フォローアップ
顧客等からの外部監査への対応
リスク評価・監査対応（証跡収集・統制モニタリング）の自動化・効率化（Vanta/Drata等 ＋ スクリプトの活用）

5. セキュリティ教育・訓練
従業員に対するセキュリティ教育やセキュリティ訓練の企画・実施・評価、および啓発コンテンツの作成

応募資格およびスキル (Must)

次のいずれかの知識・実務経験を有している
サイバーセキュリティコンサルティングに関する実務経験を有している

従業員に対するセキュリティ教育・訓練の企画・実施・運用に関する実務経験を有している

new_jobs.title: TMT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager
whose experience focuses on client development and delivery of data center projects. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully delivering various data center and mission critical projects ranging from upfront planning and pre-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive TMT (Tech, Media and Telecom) practices in the industry. In additional to managing and delivery projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Primary Responsibilities:

In the role of TMT Program Manager
, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary tech media & telecom (TMT) programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.
This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making.
Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Align and communicate with operations and market sector planning for resources, goals, and area growth in the region as they relate to the program needs you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Align, communicate, and mentor project managers within the program you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client’s site temporarily
US Citizen

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Maritime Defense Technology
new_jobs.description:
About Pole Star Defense:

Pole Star Defense is a leading provider of maritime domain awareness, maritime security, and fisheries monitoring systems to the government sector. Since 1998, we have pushed the limits of innovation, mitigating growing threats to ships, supply chains, cargo, territorial waters and, most importantly, safety of lives at sea and beyond. Today, we continue to develop and implement pioneering intelligence technologies to protect customer vessels, people, maritime domain, and reputation.

The Opportunity:

Pole Star Defense is seeking a Senior Project Manager to independently execute federal programs within our PMO. This role bridges two disciplines, requiring equal depth in federal compliance (ATO coordination, government reporting, and deliverable tracking) and Agile execution (sprint cadences and backlog management). Beyond program delivery, you will help scale the PMO by establishing organizational standards, planning templates, and handoff procedures.

The ideal candidate brings proven experience in federal government contracting, Agile methodologies, and excels at managing internal and external stakeholder relationships. We are seeking a proactive leader who will take the initiative to mature our PMO processes.

Responsibilities:

Program Delivery

Own program delivery, milestone tracking, critical path analysis, and contract timelines (periods of performance, modifications, and option exercises.
Maintain the risk register to proactively resolve issues and shield delivery teams from requirements volatility
Monitor program budgets, burn rates, and resource allocation in coordination with Finance.
Coordinate delivery across multiple internal departments without direct organizational authority

Backlog, Priorities, and Agile Delivery

Shape and sequence the backlog to ensure sprint content and workflows align directly with contract commitments.
Partner with product and engineering to translate customer intent into prioritized user stories with explicit acceptance criteria.
Participate in sprint ceremonies to provide engineering teams with critical contract and customer context
Leverage velocity and throughput metrics to predict timelines, manage scope creep, and inform customer reporting.

Government Customer Interface

Act as the daily PMO point of contact for the government program office to deliver status updates, release timelines, and risk disclosures.
Manage the Authority to Operate (ATO) lifecycle with InfoSec and the customer’s ISSO, including artifacts and continuous monitoring.
Manage incoming customer requests, translate them into internal work packages, and prevent unauthorized scope creep.

PMO Standards and Function Building

Author and improve scalable PMO standards, templates, intake procedures, and program handoff documentation.
Maintain project plans, schedules, and compliance documentation under strict version control in the PMO repository.
Contribute program and past-performance content to proposals and RFP responses.

Required Skills:

6+ years of tech/software project management experience; 3+ years supporting federal government contracts and program offices.
Deep Agile/Scrum fluency (as PM, PO, or Scrum Master) with a proven track record of managing backlogs, sequencing work, and balancing sprint flexibility with fixed contract deadlines.
Demonstrated end-to-end program ownership, including independently managing schedules, risk registers, and fluid customer relationships.
Knowledge of federal contract mechanics (mods, PoP) and security compliance workstreams (ATO/RMF).
Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills to brief both technical teams and government stakeholders.
Mastery of project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or MS Project

Additional Skills:

Experience with FedRAMP or DoD Impact Level (IL2 through IL4) cloud environments from a delivery or compliance coordination perspective
Familiarity with both front-end and back-end software development and an understanding of cloud architecture (AWS)
Related experience in the maritime technology industry

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor’s in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience.
PMP or PgMP certification
Agile certification such as CSM, PSM, or CSPO, or any other related certification

Employee Benefits:

Pole Star offers benefits that are designed to lead an evolving marketplace and

encourage a healthy balance between work and life. Highlights of those benefits are listed below:

Medical insurance for employees and their dependents (Premiums are 100% covered by the Company)
Dental and Vision insurance for employees and their dependents (Premiums are 50% covered by the Company)
Life and Disability insurance, Company funded
20 days annual leave
5 days of Wellbeing leave
Up to a 5% 401k matching
Gym membership subsidy
PTO for Volunteer Day
Refer-a-friend recruitment bonus

Work Schedule Note:

While this position is scheduled for a traditional Monday – Friday work week, our systems run 24/7/365 and as such, you may be expected to perform out of hours, on-call support on an as needed basis. Additional compensation may be available for working on-call, on standby, or during holiday hours.

This is a Public Trust position and requires completion of a State and Federal Criminal History Report (i.e., background check) as well as an FBI Summary History Report. Current and future employment will be contingent upon satisfactory completion of both the Criminal History Report and the FBI Summary History Report.

This position requires use of or access to information subject to the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”) or the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (“ITAR”). Accordingly, all applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of these regulations. Under ITAR, a U.S. person is defined as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident, or a person who is a protected individual under the immigration and Naturalization Act (8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Pole Star USA is a U.S. Government contractor and is an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Health Careers Training
new_jobs.description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

The Senior Project Manager, Health Careers Training supports the implementation and growth of the EMK-MGB Health Careers Training Partnership, a nationally recognized collaboration between Mass General Brigham (MGB), Edward M. Kennedy Academy for Health Careers (EMK), Boston Public Schools, the City of Boston, Bloomberg Philanthropies, and Bunker Hill Community College. The partnership is designed to create accessible and supportive pathways into healthcare careers for Boston students while helping address critical workforce needs across the healthcare industry.

This role is responsible for coordinating and managing career-connected learning opportunities that introduce students to healthcare careers, deepen engagement with clinical environments, and build progressive pathways from exploration to employment. The Senior Project Manager serves as a key liaison between EMK school staff, MGB clinical teams, community health programs, MGB Youth Programs and Summer Jobs, workforce development partners, and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of partnership initiatives.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, relationship-oriented, and passionate about educational and workforce opportunity. They excel at managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, thrive in dynamic environments, and are excited by the opportunity to help build innovative pathways that connect young people to meaningful careers in healthcare.

**This role will be hybrid with on-site presence at EMK and/or MGB sites 2-4 days a week depending on programming for the week. **

Program Planning & Implementation

Lead the planning and execution of 9th and 10th grade healthcare career exploration programming, including career days, hospital visits, simulations, speaker events, and clinical department engagement.
Manage all logistics for school-year and summer healthcare learning experiences, including scheduling, transportation, curriculum alignment, volunteer coordination, student supervision, and day-of operations.
Coordinate MGB's participation in the EMK Huskies Summer Bridge Program, including hospital-based career exploration and simulation experiences for rising 9th graders.
Partner with EMK staff to align programming with Career and Technical Education (CTE) curriculum, student learning objectives, and long-term partnership goals.
Coordinate financial and administrative logistics for partnership programming, including ordering supplies, arranging catering and other program-related purchases, tracking expenditures, and working with MGB Finance to secure required approvals and ensure compliance with organizational policies and funding requirements.

Clinical Partnerships & Student Pathways

Build and maintain relationships with clinical leaders and staff across MGB to support career exploration, work-based learning, and workforce pipeline initiatives.
Partner with MGB Youth Programs to expand internship access, support student success, and strengthen pathways from internships to employment.
Develop and coordinate advanced experiences for 11th and 12th grade students, including certification-aligned clinical hours, practicums, job shadowing, and other work-based learning opportunities.
Collaborate with EMK and higher education partners to create clear educational and career pathway resources connecting EMK CTE programs to advanced healthcare careers.

Community Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

Manage community-based partnerships that support EMK students and families, including the YMCA Mobile Market, Community Care Van, ThriveLink, and other health and wellness initiatives.
Serve as MGB's primary liaison for the Big Brothers Big Sisters mentoring partnership, supporting mentor recruitment, coordination, and student engagement.
Facilitate collaboration across Community Health, Workforce Development, Youth Programs, Talent Acquisition, and clinical departments to maximize partnership impact.

Advisory Committee & Leadership Engagement

Coordinate the EMK-MGB Advisory Committee, including meeting planning, stakeholder communications, agenda development, materials preparation, and follow-up activities.
Engage advisory committee members to identify and advance new clinical partnerships, mentoring opportunities, career pathways, and program enhancements.
Develop regular updates and presentations for partnership stakeholders, senior leaders, and key partners.

Communications & Storytelling

Develop public-facing communications that promote partnership impact, healthcare career pathways, and volunteer engagement opportunities.
Partner with MGB Communications, Community Health, and EMK leadership to create social media content, newsletter articles, intranet stories, presentations, and other partnership materials.
Prepare communications and presentations for funders, executive leaders, community stakeholders, and external convenings.

Data Management, Evaluation & Reporting

Maintain project plans, implementation timelines, participation data, and partnership performance metrics.
Collect, analyze, and report program outcomes to support continuous improvement, strategic decision-making, and impact measurement.
Prepare grant reports, funding updates, budget tracking materials, and performance reports for leadership and funders.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve student experiences, partnership effectiveness, and workforce outcomes through data, stakeholder feedback, and emerging best practices.
Stay informed on healthcare workforce trends, youth development strategies, and career-connected learning models to strengthen and expand partnership programming.

Note: This is a grant-funded role with funding committed through June 2029. MGB’s intent is to turn this into a permanent role once return on investment is realized from hiring EMK graduates and/or additional philanthropic funding is raised.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Education, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
5-8 years of experience in project management, education, workforce development, healthcare operations, community engagement, program management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience working with K-12 education, workforce development, youth programming, healthcare organizations, or community partnerships strongly preferred.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to engage effectively with students, educators, clinicians, administrators, and community partners.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation development and facilitation.
Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting program outcomes and performance metrics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management/data tracking systems.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across interdisciplinary teams.
Commitment to advancing educational opportunity, workforce equity, and healthcare career pathways.

Working Conditions

Hybrid position with regular onsite presence at both EMK and MGB locations (2-4 days/week)
Frequent travel between EMK, MGH, BWH, and other MGB sites in Greater Boston required
Occasional evening or weekend availability required for student events, community activities, and partnership meetings
Ability to supervise student activities in school, hospital, and community settings

About RSI Lab
Sakana AI Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab は、AIの開発プロセスそのものを設計し直すことを担う専任の研究グループです。CEOのDavid Haと直接連携しながら、次のフロンティアAIのアーキテクチャを構築しています。RSI Labでは、とりわけ研究サイエンティストとソフトウェアエンジニアの二つのポジションを中心にチームを立ち上げています。

Role Overview
RSI Labの研究活動を支えるプログラムマネージャーを募集します。トップクラスの研究者・エンジニアが研究に専念できるよう、スケジュール管理・対外コミュニケーション・予算管理を含む研究オペレーション全般を担っていただきます。研究者と対等に技術的な会話ができる方と、社内外のステークホルダーを動かす実行力を兼ね備えた方を求めています。
What You Will Do
RSI Labの研究プロジェクトについて、スケジュール管理・進行管理・予算管理を担い、研究者が研究に専念できる体制を構築する
研究の進捗・成果を技術的に理解し、研究者と直接対話しながら計画と実態のギャップを把握・調整する
社外パートナーとの窓口業務を含む、対外コミュニケーションを担当する
研究チームの採用・オンボーディングに関わる社内プロセスを推進する
CEOおよびリーダーシップチームに対し、プロジェクトの状況を定期的に報告する

Who We Are Looking For
AI/ML分野の研究内容を理解し、リサーチャーと技術的な会話ができる方(自身での研究実施は必須ではありません)
国際的なチーム環境で、日本語・英語の両方を使って業務を進められる方(折衝・文書作成含む)
予算管理・プロジェクトマネジメント・対外折衝のいずれかの実務経験
複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な環境での調整経験がある方は歓迎

Note
本ロールは、Member of Technical Staff (RSI Lab)のような研究職ポジションとは異なり、研究を支えるプログラム運営を専門とする職種です。ご自身の技術的背景がリサーチャー職に合致する場合は、そちらのポジションもご検討ください。

About RSI Lab
The Sakana AI Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab is a dedicated research group within Sakana AI, tasked with redesigning the AI development process itself with AI. By transitioning from static, human-led R&D to autonomous, self-improving intelligence engines, we are turning constraints into our greatest compounding advantage. We are building the definitive architecture for the next frontier of AI. The Lab is actively scaling both research and engineering resources at our Tokyo headquarters, seeking exceptional, highly driven individuals to join us across two core profiles: Frontier Research Scientists and Advanced Core Engineers.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Program Manager to support the research operations of RSI Lab. As the Lab scales its research and engineering resources to engineer the next great leap in computational intelligence, this role covers budget management, schedule management, and external communications, ensuring our researchers and engineers can focus fully on research at maximum velocity. We’re looking for someone who can hold their own in technical conversations with researchers, while also driving execution across internal and external stakeholders.
What You Will Do
Own budget management, schedule management, and progress tracking across RSI Lab’s research projects, building a structure that lets researchers stay focused on research
Understand research progress and outcomes at a technical level, working directly with researchers to identify and close gaps between plan and reality
Serve as a point of contact for external partners, including relevant communications
Drive internal processes related to hiring and onboarding for the research team
Report project status regularly to the CEO and leadership team

Who We Are Looking For
Understands AI/ML research content well enough to have technical conversations with researchers (hands-on research experience not required)
Comfortable working collaboratively within an international team using both Japanese and English, including negotiation and document production in both languages
Experience in budget management, project management, or external negotiation
Experience coordinating in complex environments involving multiple stakeholders is a plus

Note
This role is distinct from research positions such as Member of Technical Staff (RSI Lab); it is focused on program operations that support research, not research itself. If your technical background aligns more with a research role, we encourage you to consider that position instead.

Senior Project Manager

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. Digitalization. Simply delivered.

You are project management aficionado, therefore you have a good understanding of project management methodologies & principles and strong communication & stakeholder management skills. Working in a multinational environment, you can expect cross-region collaboration with teams around the globe, thus being advanced in spoken and written English and having ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language is a must.

#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace#ProjectManagement #AI#FutureOfWork

Grow together

Join our team and help shape the future of DHL Express by driving the delivery of business-critical digital solutions that support our end-to-end operations, from pickup to delivery.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of strategic IT initiatives. In this role, you will collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to translate business objectives into actionable project plans, manage project scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery of solutions that create measurable business value.

Our teams leverage modern product development practices, including microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Agile methodologies, and reusable solution design. As a Senior Project Manager, you will coordinate cross-functional teams across frontend, backend, integration, and data platforms to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business needs.

You will play a key role in DHL Express's digital transformation by leading projects throughout the entire delivery lifecycle, from demand intake and requirements definition through development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. The position offers a unique opportunity to gain end-to-end visibility of complex enterprise solutions while working with global stakeholders across business and technology functions.

As Senior Project Manager you will be responsible for:

Planning: Defining the project's scope, goals, and objectives.
Budgeting: Estimating costs, establishing budgets, and tracking spending.
Risk management: Identifying potential risks early and developing mitigation strategies.
Team management: Assigning tasks based on team members' skills and experience, and ensuring team members are performing to their best potential.
Communication: Communicating withing & cross team members, external partners, and business stakeholders to determine project dependencies, status and identify potential roadblocks.
Issue resolution: Ensuring issues related to scope, budget, and resource allocation are resolved effectively.

The successful candidate is expected to have expert working knowledge of NIST information system protection policies and Risk Management Framework (RMF) procedures and tools, as prescribed within the Joint Special Access Program (SAP) Implementation Guide (JSIG), as applied to industrial control systems, test equipment, and specialized lab/production computing environments.

new_jobs.description:
Sakana AIでは、自然界から発想を得るユニークな生成AI技術により、世界に先駆ける研究開発を行っています。私たちはその研究成果を、国家の安全保障を支える領域——サイバーセキュリティ——に実装しようとしています。

本ポジションでは、防衛省を含む政府機関および防衛関連企業に対し、生成AIを活用したサイバーセキュリティ事業の営業推進とプロジェクトマネジメントを担っていただきます。脆弱性診断やペネトレーションテストといったオフェンシブセキュリティの知見と、防御・運用側の課題を捉えるディフェンシブセキュリティの理解を併せ持ち、セキュリティエンジニアやAIリサーチャーと対等に議論しながら、提案から実行までをEnd-to-Endで牽引していただきます。
本ポジションはフルタイム、勤務地は日本となり、ビジネスレベル以上の日本語能力（N1目安）があることが求められます（ビジネスレベルの英語力があれば尚可）。

役割と責任

防衛分野のサイバーセキュリティにおける困難な課題を、アカウントマネージャー、エンジニア、AIリサーチャーと協働しながら特定し、AIを活用したソリューションとして提案・実行する
防衛省を含む政府機関および防衛関連企業との強固な関係を構築・維持し、新たなビジネスチャンスを開拓する
諸外国における防衛・サイバーセキュリティ分野の技術動向を踏まえた提案戦略を策定し、「そもそも何をどう作るか」からリードする
クライアントとの要件調整、期待値調整、課題整理を主導する
プロジェクト全体の品質・コスト・スケジュールに責任を持ち、確実なデリバリーを完遂する
開発チームのメンバーや技術パートナーと円滑なコミュニケーションを取り、プロジェクトのゴールに向けてチームを牽引・サポートする

応募資格およびスキル（Must）

サイバーセキュリティまたは防衛分野での5年以上の実務経験があり、以下のいずれかを想定
(i) 経営コンサルティングファームやシンクタンクにおいて、防衛省を含む政府機関のサイバーセキュリティ関連プロジェクトを主導した経験
(ii) セキュリティ専業企業において、脆弱性診断・ペネトレーションテスト等のサービス提供やその営業・デリバリーに携わった経験
(iii) 防衛分野のメーカーや商社において、防衛関連の政府機関向けに営業・プロジェクト推進を担当した経験
サイバーセキュリティの全体像に関する体系的な知見。特に、脆弱性診断やペネトレーションテストとは何か、セキュリティエンジニアが実務で何を行っているかを理解し、専門ベンダーのエンジニアと技術的な会話ができること。
エンタープライズまたは政府機関向けプロジェクトにおけるプロジェクトマネジメントの実務経験（ソフトウェア開発プロジェクトに限らない）。チームビルディング、タスク・課題管理、スケジュール管理、品質管理を自律的に遂行できること。
クライアントとの要件調整、期待値調整、課題整理を含む深い折衝経験と、要件定義書・計画書・課題管理表などのハイクオリティなドキュメンテーション能力があること。
生成AIやデータ基盤に関する基本的な仕組みの理解（API利用、モデル特性、データ前提、コスト・セキュリティ観点など）と、最新トレンドに自らキャッチアップする姿勢

歓迎要件（Nice to Have）

防衛分野・政府調達における法令・規制、ガイドラインの把握（防衛産業サイバーセキュリティ基準、装備品等の調達に係る秘密保全対策ガイドライン、防衛産業保全マニュアル、防衛事業適合事業者制度、ISMAP、NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171 等）

金融機関をはじめとする事業会社との強固な関係を構築・維持し、新たなビジネスチャンスを開拓する
クライアントとの要件調整、期待値調整、課題整理をリードし、「そもそも何をどう作るか」という戦略策定を主導する
プロジェクト全体の品質・コスト・スケジュールに責任を持ち、確実なデリバリーを完遂する
開発チームのメンバーや技術パートナーと円滑なコミュニケーションを取り、プロジェクトのゴールに向けてチームを牽引・サポートする

応募資格およびスキル (Must)

サイバーセキュリティ領域での5年以上の実務経験があり、以下のいずれかを想定
(i) 経営コンサルティングファームやシンクタンクにおいて、サイバーセキュリティ領域のプロジェクトを主導した経験
(ii) サイバーセキュリティ企業において、脆弱性診断・ペネトレーションテスト等のサービス提供やその営業・デリバリーに携わった経験
(iii) 金融機関・事業会社のセキュリティ部門において、セキュリティ施策の企画・推進を主導した経験

サイバーセキュリティの全体像に関する体系的な知見。特に、脆弱性診断やペネトレーションテストとは何か、セキュリティエンジニアが実務で何を行っているかを理解し、専門ベンダーのエンジニアと技術的な会話ができること。
エンタープライズ向けプロジェクトにおけるプロジェクトマネジメントの実務経験。チームビルディング、タスク・課題管理、スケジュール管理、品質管理を自律的に遂行できること。

At Sakana AI, we conduct world-leading research and development in unique generative AI technologies inspired by nature. We are now bringing the results of this research into the domain that protects society’s most critical foundations: cybersecurity.
In this position, you will drive business development and project management for our generative AI-powered cybersecurity business, serving major enterprises including financial institutions. You will combine offensive security knowledge—such as vulnerability assessment and penetration testing—with an understanding of defensive security and the challenges faced on the defense and operations side. Engaging with security engineers and AI researchers as an equal, you will lead engagements end-to-end, from proposal to execution.
This is a full-time position based in Japan, regardless of the candidate’s background. Business-level or higher Japanese proficiency (JLPT N1 level is a guideline) is required. Business-level English proficiency is a plus.

Roles and Responsibilities

Identify customers’ most difficult cybersecurity challenges in collaboration with account managers, engineers, and AI researchers, and propose and execute AI-powered solutions.
Build and maintain strong relationships with enterprises, including financial institutions, and pioneer new business opportunities.
Lead requirements coordination, expectation management, and issue structuring with clients, and drive the strategy of what to build and how to build it.
Take ownership of quality, cost, and schedule across the entire project and ensure reliable delivery.
Communicate closely with development team members and technology partners, leading and supporting the team toward project goals.

5+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity, in one of the following areas:
(i) Experience leading cybersecurity projects at a management consulting firm or think tank.
(ii) Experience delivering, selling, or managing services such as vulnerability assessment and penetration testing at a cybersecurity company.
(iii) Experience leading the planning and execution of security initiatives in the security division of a financial institution or enterprise.

Systematic knowledge of the overall cybersecurity landscape. In particular, a solid understanding of what vulnerability assessments and penetration tests are and what security engineers do in practice, with the ability to hold technical conversations with engineers at specialized security vendors.
Hands-on project management experience in enterprise projects, with the ability to autonomously drive team building, task and issue management, schedule management, and quality management.
Deep client-facing experience, including requirements coordination, expectation management, and issue structuring, along with the ability to produce high-quality documentation such as requirements definitions, project plans, and issue trackers.
A fundamental understanding of generative AI and data infrastructure (API usage, model characteristics, data requirements, cost and security considerations, etc.), and a proactive attitude toward keeping up with the latest trends.

Qualifications and Skills (Preferred)

Familiarity with laws, regulations, and guidelines in the financial sector (e.g., the Guidelines for Cybersecurity in the Financial Sector, FISC Security Guidelines, CRI Profile).
Experience driving upstream phases such as requirements definition, technology selection, and architecture design, as well as projects involving PoC and technical validation phases.
Experience in requirements structuring, design, and risk management for systems leveraging generative AI (AI agents, embeddings, RAG, etc.).
Experience in team management and talent development on development projects, and related certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, Registered Information Security Specialist (RISS), or CISSP.

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

The Technical Project Manager, UCaaS owns the delivery of Harbor IT's unified communications and voice implementations from executed agreement through client handoff to support. This is a senior, client-facing role inside the UCaaS onboarding team. The person in this seat runs the full project lifecycle for cloud voice, contact center, and carrier migration work: kickoff and initiation, discovery and data collection, project planning, cutover execution, monitoring, training, and closeout. Unlike a general infrastructure PM, this role carries a real technical component. The Technical Project Manager must understand dial plans, number porting, call flow and routing design, session border controllers, network readiness and QoS, E911 compliance, and the dependencies between the voice platform and the underlying LAN, WAN, and firewall. They translate that technical detail into plans, risk registers, and change orders a client executive can act on. They direct project engineers, field technicians, trainers, carriers, and subcontractors without direct reporting authority. While the UCaaS practice is the primary focus, this role will also require exposure to or management of IT, data network, and/or cybersecurity projects as the delivery pipeline requires. Ultimately this person is accountable for the success or failure of assigned projects, for on-time and on-budget delivery, and for client satisfaction at handoff.

Key Responsibilities

Own UCaaS, cloud voice, contact center, and carrier migration projects end to end, from executed agreement through closeout and transition to the Support Center.
Serve as the client's primary point of contact across all project phases: kickoff and initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout.
Build and maintain project plans that identify scope, resources, tasks, dependencies, milestones, and timelines, and hold the plan current as conditions change.
Lead technical discovery and data collection for voice cutovers, including dial plan design, number inventory and porting, call flow and routing requirements, user and device provisioning, E911 and regulatory compliance, and network readiness assessment covering QoS, bandwidth, PoE, and firewall/SBC configuration.
Coordinate carrier and vendor activity including LOA submission, port scheduling, circuit delivery, and escalation, and hold carriers accountable to committed dates.
Plan and run cutover events including cutover runbooks, rollback criteria, after-hours execution windows, day-one support coverage, and post-cutover stabilization.
Document, quantify, and communicate project risk. Mitigate where possible or proceed under documented and accepted risk with client sign-off.
Schedule and direct project resources including project engineers, field technicians, trainers, associate PMs, carriers, and subcontractors, and delegate effectively without direct reporting authority.
Author and deliver project documentation including project plans, discovery questionnaires, cutover runbooks, training materials, change orders, as-built documentation, and signoff packages.
Manage project budget and margin, issue change orders for out-of-scope work, and prevent eroding project profitability from scope creep. .
Log hours and project detail in ConnectWise Manage accurately and on time, and keep client configuration records current in the customer database.
Escalate project and client issues to Client Success and Operations Management on a timely basis, and drive resolution rather than handing off the problem.
Support pre-sales when required by scoping project involvement, drafting statements of work, and budgeting project labor.
Contribute to the maturity of the project management practice through templates, methodology, scope-of-work improvements, and internal training on project workflow and internal process.
Maintain PMP or similar project management certification and current working knowledge of the UCaaS platforms Harbor IT delivers.

Qualifications & Skills

Demonstrated command of the full project management lifecycle including scope definition, planning, risk management, budget and change control, and formal closeout.
Hands-on working knowledge of UCaaS and cloud voice delivery: dial plan design, number porting and LNP, call routing and auto-attendant/IVR flow, SIP trunking, session border controllers, E911, and MACD processes.
Working knowledge of the network layer voice depends on, including QoS, VLAN segmentation, PoE, bandwidth planning, firewall and NAT traversal, and SD-WAN.
Proven ability to plan and execute cutover events with defined rollback criteria, including after-hours and weekend windows.
Excellent written and oral communication, including the ability to brief technologists, operations managers, and C-suite executives on the same project with the right level of detail for each.
Ability to hold carriers, vendors, and subcontractors accountable to committed dates and quality standards.
Comfort managing multiple concurrent projects across clients without dropping detail or missing commitments.
Proficiency with project management tooling such as Smartsheet, MS Project, and Microsoft Teams, and with PSA systems, ideally ConnectWise Manage.
Comfort operating in an EOS-managed, growth-stage MSP/MSSP environment with shared accountability across teams.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
5 or more years managing technology implementation projects, with at least 3 years focused on voice, unified communications, or UCaaS delivery.
Direct delivery experience with one or more major UCaaS or cloud voice platforms, for example Intermedia Unite/Elevate, ZoomPhone, Cisco/Webex Calling, Microsoft Teams Phone, RingCentral, or 8x8.
Experience delivering projects in a managed services provider, VAR, telecom integrator, or carrier professional services environment.
PMP certification preferred. Platform and vendor certifications relevant to the UCaaS stack are a plus.
Experience with ConnectWise Manage PSA and preferred.

Work Environment

Reports to the Manager of UCaaS Onboarding within Harbor IT's professional services organization, operating under an EOS framework with shared accountability across delivery teams.
Hybrid role based out of the Framingham, MA headquarters with remote flexibility. Some local and regional client travel may be required (less than 10%).
Direct and frequent client exposure across mid-market and enterprise accounts. After-hours and occasional weekend work is required for cutover events and project deadlines.

Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience
Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Unlimited PTO and standard holidays
Professional development opportunities

The Pay Range For This Role Is

80,000 - 95,000 USD per year (Harbor Networks)

Key Responsibilities:

Ensures the timely and accurate delivery of contract deliverables and key project artifacts across multiple projects.
Serves as the primary point of contact with key customers for implementation of GHX core products, leading coordination calls and aligning GHX activities with customer activities.
Leads and facilitates project “kickoff“ sessions to review assumptions and expectations, gather requirements, educate internal stakeholders on products and services, etc.

new_jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

HDR is looking for an experienced practitioner in fisheries engineering, restoration, and ecohydraulics to be a part of our thriving team in the Pacific Northwest practice area. This is an opportunity to join an established, highly successful team already solving the most challenging fisheries related engineering work throughout the West Coast. The candidate will be responsible for providing technical expertise at the project level and assisting with growing HDRs fisheries program through development of client relationships and identification of opportunities for expansion of HDR s suite of environmental and water resource related services. Responsibilities will include technical work, mentoring, team building, project management, business development, and client management. The candidate will also be responsible for establishing technical and project management strategies that emphasize quality, staff development, client satisfaction, and financial responsibility utilizing HDRs technology, standards, and project delivery practices. The primary duties of this position include planning, directing, and monitoring all aspects of large multi-discipline projects or medium sized projects with high degree of technical complexity. The candidate will be involved with the production and coordination of several projects concurrently. This position offers additional opportunities for travel and working within other regions of practice across the United States and Canada.

In the role of Senior Project Manager - Fisheries
, we'll count on you to:

Direct and coordinate work of single or multidiscipline teams throughout the project's lifecycle (from development & initiation to close-out)
Responsible for all aspects of large multidiscipline projects or medium-sized projects with high degree of technical complexity, involving a large project staff
Produce and coordinate several projects concurrently
Establish and maintain client relations, and be involved with marketing, contractual, design and production meetings
Conduct work sessions for deliverable development in conjunction with other staff and stakeholders
Coordinate staffing and workload through entire project life cycle, and ensure completion of deliverables on schedule
Track financial aspects of projects, and coordinate and adjust work effort with team to ensure that work is completed within parameters of agreed-to budget and schedule
Work with the Accounting, Operational and Business leadership for periodic project reviews
Implement QA/QC procedures
Supervise large project staffs and act as mentor for less-experienced Project Managers
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing projects and tasks.
Experience performing planning, design development, contract documentation, preparation of plans and specifications construction engineering oversight on a wide variety of water resource projects.
Experience leading, directing, and mentoring technical staff. Experience interfacing with a broad range of science and engineering disciplines.
Experience conducting or managing 1D/2D/3D hydraulic modeling to support planning and design of a wide range of projects including stream rehabilitation and restoration, fish passage, fish behavior, screened surface water intakes, complex culverts and bridges, and floodplain management (planning and design).
Experience leading and participating in the preparation of technical and non-technical reports and presentations including visualization of data.
Experience with business development activities including client relations, marketing pursuits, and project proposals

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
10 years related experience
A minimum 5 years project management experience
Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license.
MS Office and MS Project experience (Access experience would be plus)
Demonstrated leadership, business development and strategic planning skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. new_jobs.title: 【Ai Workforce】AIコンサルタント(Deployment Strategist) _金融
new_jobs.description:
事業概要

すべての経済活動のデジタル化を目指す株式会社LayerXは、Ai Workforce事業部において、「AIを業務に溶け込ませる」をコンセプトとした生成AIプラットフォーム「Ai Workforce」を開発・提供しています。
Ai Workforce事業部は2023年に発足した新規事業チームであり、幅広い業界のエンタープライズ企業パートナーとの取り組みを積み重ねてきました。大規模言語モデル（LLM）などのAIの技術は飛躍的に発展していますが、それ単体では本格的な業務で使うことが難しく、そのギャップを埋めるUX (AI-UX) を実現することを目指しています。
実証実験（PoC）ではなく、プロダクトとして既に続々とお客様にご導入いただいており、AIのポテンシャルを活かす更なるプロダクトの進化や、市場の拡大に取り組んでいます。

募集背景

Ai Workforce事業部では、日本を代表する大手企業を対象に、生成AIプラットフォーム「Ai Workforce」を開発・提供しています。
デプロイメントストラテジストは、エンジニアと協同してプロジェクトをリードし、プラットフォームが提供する「ナレッジ」「スキル」「ツール」「UI」という4種類のコンポーネントを自在に組み合わせ、顧客・業界単位で最適なAIエージェントを創り上げることをミッションとしています。
金融業界は、「膨大な非構造データ」と「厳密なルール」に基づく情報産業であり、膨大な書類の確認・審査等の人間がテキストを読んで判断・作成する業務が多く、LLM導入により劇的なコスト削減や収益向上が見込める領域です。
金融機関は「産業の血液」とも言われます。金融という心臓部をLLMにより強化することで、日本産業全体を力強く駆動します。

業務内容

プロジェクトマネジメント: 顧客の業務プロセスやAI活用方針を深く分析し、AIエージェント構築のプロジェクト設計を行います。
AIエージェント設計: エンジニア（Forward Deployed Engineer）とペアを組み、Ai Workforceの4つのコンポーネント（ナレッジ、スキル、ツール、UI）を組み合わせ、顧客・業界単位で最適化されたAIエージェントを設計・構築します。
プロダクトマネジメント: 上記4つのコンポーネント自体の機能追加やバージョンアップに関するプロダクトマネジメントを担当します。
新規ソリューションの立ち上げ: 個々の案件で得られた知見を体系化し、業界・職務単位で汎用的な「ソリューション」として企画・開発します。

ポジションの魅力

コンサルタントとしての強みを土台に、自分自身の手で事業やプロダクトを作る経験やキャリアを構築できます。
エンジニア（Forward Deployed Engineer）と密接に協働し、AIの先端技術が大企業や社会に実装していく過程に深く関与できます。

new_jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Work You'll Do

As a Project Delivery PROJECT - Security Engineer II on the project, you will:

Technology Risk Research: Conduct targeted research on materiel, hardware components, and software utilized in Army systems. Evaluate the overarching risk to critical technologies.
Vulnerability & Threat Analysis: Identify specific vulnerabilities within proposed technologies. Analyze adversarial attack vectors and assess how foreign threats target DoD systems.
BOM Analysis: Deconstruct and analyze Bills of Materials (BOMs) for complex systems. Identify risky, compromised, or counterfeit components within the technical supply chain.
Systems Contextualization: Apply a deep understanding of Army weapons platforms and tactical systems. Translate abstract technical vulnerabilities into concrete operational risks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Entity analysts to fuse technical vulnerabilities with corporate risk. Work closely with government engineers to align threat data with system requirements.

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Cyber Defense & Resilience offering assists clients in defending against advanced threats by transforming security operations, monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence. Helps manage and protect dynamic attack surfaces and provides rapid crisis and cyber incident response, ensuring clients can be ready for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Active TS/SCI clearance
Ability to work onsite up to four days a week in Arlington, VA.
4+ years of professional experience within the following:
In classified intelligence analysis, DoD or IC cyber threat research, or technical/cyber analysis in a classified environment.
Technical Acumen: Strong background in evaluating hardware, software, and critical technologies with a strong preference for intelligence systems or weapons experience. Candidates must understand technical supply chains, BOMs, and cyber-physical attack vectors.
Domain Knowledge: Solid familiarity with DoD systems, weapons platforms, and the defense acquisition lifecycle. Experience with the IC is highly desirable.
Tradecraft: Proven ability to apply Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) and All-Source methodologies to technical problem sets. Experience with Technical Intelligence or classified Cyber Threat Intelligence is highly desired.

new_jobs.title: Corporate Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We're looking for a Corporate Security Analyst to join our rapidly growing CorpSec team. This role is for someone who is passionate about corporate security and building on existing frameworks, and is available to candidates local to one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto). You will be expected to be in-office a minimum of twice per week.

CorpSec is transitioning and growing at Clio into a focused, mission-driven function with security systems and practices already in place. Your team works closely with IT Systems, Application Security, People, Compliance, and IT Services to ensure appropriate security coverage in detection, response, and establishing non-adversarial techniques.

The Corporate Security Analyst will be responsible for adopting and unifying systems, communication, and oversight across IT Systems, Application Security, and Compliance. You will build upon existing trust, define a unified approach, and formalize the program in accordance with compliance requirements. You will build upon existing trust, work with a unified approach, and support the program in accordance with compliance requirements.

What you’ll do:

This role acts as an operator of Clio's corporate security toolset, owning the endpoint tools, investigative processes, and organizational culture required to protect Clio from internal and external threats - both accidental and intentional. You own the day-to-day execution: monitoring alerts, triaging DLP events, running investigations, and keeping the systems that protect Clio running reliably. You don't need to have all the answers - but you need to determine what you don't know, ask the right questions, and close the loop on everything you own.

Build & Run: Monitor and triage DLP alerts to surface real signals from noise and operate EDR day-to-day by reviewing detections and executing response procedures. You’re naturally curious about how the tools you operate actually work, not just how to use them.
Drive Education: Run phishing simulation campaigns end-to-end - from scheduling to employee education loops - while ensuring that no one is left guessing by communicating clearly when something breaks.
Incident Response: Handle L1/L2 security incidents (phishing, device compromise, data loss) by triaging and containing threats. You take pride in ensuring that alerts don’t age in your queue.
Optimize Systems: Maintain runbooks and support compliance evidence collection (SOC 2, ISO 27001). You adapt when priorities shift and don't need perfect information to make progress.
Technical Growth: Develop scripts to drive auto-remediation and tune security tooling for AI detection to address unauthorized data moves.
Collaborate: Engage with a security culture that solicits feedback and drives visibility across Clio’s security stack (Okta, 1Password, Google Workspace, MDM).

What you bring:

2-4 years of hands-on experience in a security operations, IT security, or endpoint support role.
Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with EDR, DLP, Phishing, SSO Platforms, or Google Workspace security controls.
Analytical Mindset: A healthy curiosity to look for the "why" and fix the problem rather than the symptom.
Communication: Clear, evidence-first written communication. You document what you did, what you found, and what you decided.
Judgment: You know when to figure something out independently and when to ask for help.
Demonstrate a keen interest in improving your craft by using AI

Bonus if you have:

Hands-on familiarity with MDM or SIEM in a security incident context.
Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence collection.
Exposure to scripting (Python, Bash) for automating investigation or remediation tasks.
Relevant certifications: CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or equivalent.

This is a new role.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $119,000 to $161,000 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.
